designAnswers.whichCallRaisesTheTypeError: The parent's diagnosis (and U93's behavior sentence on origin/main) says the two route rows, with the pin flipped to true, fail with TypeError: The "path" argument must be of type string ... Received undefined because the create route reaches a campaign-journal database path the harness never set up. Measured here it is otherwise. (1) On the baseline the TypeError is raised by the suite's own afterEach, `await rm(dir, ...)` at coopMatchRosterSourceVersion.test.ts:311:13: the beforeEach assertion at :298:49 throws before `dir = await mkdtemp(...)` at :299 runs, so `dir` is undefined when afterEach removes it. It is a secondary failure of the flag pin, raised on all three route rows (including the 400 row), not a route or journal path. (2) With only the pin flipped to true (probe, restored to sha256 7d9b97cf9a4a733ce1251ca3fcb91088fe3f34c47fd127a047f53c50b8a7f6e9), no TypeError appears: the two 201 rows fail with status 500 and error "Campaign creation checkpoint failed at genesis-branch: genesis branch is not committed", and the 400 row passes (2 failed, 8 passed). The cause is the creation checkpoint's genesis-branch stage (campaignCreationCheckpoint.ts:212-222), which under journal authority reads the genesis marker (campaignCreationCheckpointPorts.ts:35-36, readCampaignMigrationMarker) and the harness never appended a genesis.
designAnswers.setupTheRepinnedSuitePerformsThatU88Lack: multiplayerCoopCreationCheckpoint.test.ts:154-164 appends the host campaign's genesis after saveCampaign: appendCampaignGenesis(new SQLiteEventJournal(getSQLiteService().getDatabase(), () => GENESIS_AT), writeCampaignMigrationMarker, { envelope, occurredAt: GENESIS_AT }) and expects kind genesis-appended. U88's persistHostCampaign (:319-337) only calls saveCampaign. The SQLite database itself is already set up by both suites' beforeEach (getSQLiteService({ path }).initialize()); nothing else differs in the harness.
designAnswers.responseUnderJournalAuthority: Still 201: the route answers res.status(201) at index.ts:341 once the checkpoint commits, and the re-pinned suite expects 201 (createdMatchId, multiplayerCoopCreationCheckpoint.test.ts:188; rows :259, :289). Without a genesis it answers 500 (index.ts:335), which the re-pinned suite expects only for the no-genesis row (:319-330, expect 500 at :329). The registered host state is body.coopCampaign.state (index.ts:329), so sourceVersion 3 comes from the posted body.
designAnswers.flagPinAssertTrueOrRemove: The re-pinned suite carries no flag assertion at all; it states its premise in a comment (:120-126) and seeds the genesis whatever the flag. The charter's unit behaviour asks the beforeEach to state the flag's real value (true, no override), so the pin is flipped to toBe(true) rather than removed. Consequence recorded under the local mutants: removing it is not caught (the seeded genesis makes the rows pass either way); inverting it is.
